catalysts.asymmetry: Positive order/backlog evidence can force estimate revisions.
catalysts.event: Next earnings update on backlog, orders, and AI infrastructure demand

candidate.consensus_view: Consensus recognizes AI demand but mostly rewards obvious semiconductor exposure.

fit_evidence.claim: VST has identifiable AI power/grid exposure.
fit_evidence.title: VST mentioned as AI infrastructure beneficiary

candidate.name: Vistra
candidate.potential_variant_view: Power scarcity is relevant, but merchant-power cyclicality makes the edge less clean.
candidate.thematic_fit: VST is tied to data-center electrification and grid/power capacity demand under the AI infrastructure theme.

variant_evidence.claim: VST variant view is underappreciated relative to consensus focus.
variant_evidence.title: VST grid/power optionality remains debated

conviction.reasoning: Fundamental view agrees with consensus; without a differentiated estimate or expectation edge, there is no tradeable advantage.

bear_case_evidence.claim: VST is exposed to cyclical industrial demand.
bear_case_evidence.title: VST macro sensitivity remains a risk

business_quality.moat_assessment: Scale, installed base, and channel depth support pricing power.
business_quality.summary: Vistra has meaningful exposure to infrastructure spending and enough business quality to warrant a structured review.

conviction.justification: VST has enough evidence for a moderate stub rating, with explicit variant evidence and a named uncertainty.
conviction.primary_uncertainty: Macro conditions or earnings revisions could move against the theme before the market reprices the opportunity.

estimates_and_expectations.consensus_summary: Consensus expects steady growth but remains cautious on macro-sensitive industrial demand.

positioning.institutional_positioning: High-quality buyers are present, but generalists still debate whether the AI grid demand is durable.

fundamental.steelman_bear_case: The bear case is that AI data-center demand is pulled forward, industrial demand rolls over as rates stay high, and backlog normalizes before estimates can move materially higher.
fundamental.thesis_statement: VST can compound earnings above consensus as AI infrastructure demand pulls forward power and grid investment.
fundamental.what_bear_case_misses: The bear case underweights the duration of utility and data-center capex plans, which are tied to multi-year power constraints rather than one quarter of industrial activity.
